items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: That's where my little brother learned, under T.O.

ctx.x: Last time I saw Tats, downtown I was talking to him on Clever and in Dumain one night, and Tats told me he couldn't play no more either, because he had that stroke, you know. Yeah. But that was a good sax man too, clarinet man. Well they came underneath T.O., Lorenzi T.O. Lorenzi T.O. Lorenzi T.O. was the greatest the city had. That's where my little brother learned, under T.O.
Yeah. Well, how old is your little brother?
